title: The Face of Persuasion: Analyzing Bias and Generating Culture-Aware Ads

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing racial distributions in real and generated advertisement datasets using facial analysis (DeepFace), and conducting controlled demographic swap experiments to evaluate MLLM/LLM persuasion preferences between identical ad images differing only by race.

Analyzing gender distributions across different ad topics in real and generated datasets using facial analysis, and evaluating MLLM/LLM persuasion preferences and reasoning via controlled demographic swap experiments.

Predicting the target country of dataset ads using an MLLM to identify Western over-representation, and evaluating text-to-image models' ability to generate culturally appropriate, country-specific ads using VQA-scores and human evaluation.
